description.en-US: Bede's short allegorical interpretation of the Book of Tobit. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: A breve interpretação alegórica de Beda ao Livro de Tobias.

sources.edition: Allegorica interpretatio in Tobiam on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
